description: This file defines the PrefItem class, which manages preference items with key-value pairs and hierarchical child items, including validation of keys.

classes.name: PrefItem
classes.description: A class representing a preference item with key-value pairs and hierarchical child preference items, including validation for keys.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the preference item after validating the key.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable iterable of all key-value pairs.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given key.

methods.name: createChild
methods.description: Creates a new child PrefItem, adds it to the children list, and returns it.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable iterable of child PrefItems.

methods.name: validKey
methods.description: Validates that the key matches a specific pattern of allowed characters; throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds an existing PrefItem as a child to this PrefItem.
